citations.claim: classical ownership of the full-period criterion for mixed congruential generators
citations.source: T. E. Hull and A. R. Dobell, Random Number Generators, SIAM Review 4 (1962), 230--254

exact_identities.formula: v_p(S_n)=v_p(n) for odd p and p|(a-1)

frozen_object.arithmetic_origin: intrinsic finite ring, its prime-power quotients, and CRT
frozen_object.determinant_convention: source Artin--Mazur zeta only; no target determinant
frozen_object.forbidden_data: target primes or zeros, arithmetic local factors, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, target divisor or functional equation, Hilbert--Polya operators
frozen_object.normalization: least nonnegative residues; one full orbit means one m-cycle
frozen_object.state: x in Z/mZ with integer m>=2

headline: Every mixed congruential map on Z/mZ has one cycle through all m states exactly under the Hull--Dobell prime-power conditions; the CRT proof, primitive ledger, zeta, and Koopman spectrum are exact.
nonclaims: literature priority beyond the cited classical criterion
that every nonadmissible affine map has a classified cycle decomposition
a rational-prime primitive-orbit dictionary or logarithmic prime clock
target arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, divisor, or functional equation
a target Fredholm determinant, Hilbert--Polya operator, or Route-B authorization

route_a.strongest_failure: No rational-prime orbit dictionary, log-prime clock, target divisor, global target analytic structure, or Hilbert--Polya identification exists.
route_a.strongest_positive: Prime-power quotient dynamics, CRT assembly, the complete primitive cycle, source zeta, and same-clock unitary Koopman lift are analytic.

theorem.boundaries: Failure of the unit increment, a prime congruence, or the mod-4 condition obstructs a full cycle; m=1 is excluded as the trivial one-state face.
theorem.criterion: F is one m-cycle iff gcd(c,m)=1, every prime p|m divides a-1, and 4|a-1 whenever 4|m.
theorem.crt: The coprime local periods p^e have lcm m, hence every seed lies on the same m-cycle.
theorem.fixed_counts: #Fix(F^n)=m when m divides n and 0 otherwise.
theorem.koopman: The counting-measure Koopman permutation is unitary with all m-th roots of unity once each.
theorem.local_return: On every p^e factor satisfying the criterion, the return-gap p-adic valuation equals v_p(n), so every state has exact period p^e.
theorem.primitive: The admissible map has one primitive orbit of length m and no other orbit.
theorem.route_boundary: Prime-power CRT structure is intrinsic but supplies no rational-prime orbit dictionary, logarithmic clock, target divisor, or Hilbert--Polya spectrum.
